interpretation.p99_60s_meaning: Reflects single-model 122B inference latency at ~30 tok/s on this hardware. A 200-token chat response requires >6s pure generation. Concurrent chat workloads pile against the single loaded LM Studio instance; this is the model+hardware ceiling, not a product defect.
interpretation.scaling_path: For higher throughput either (a) load a smaller LM Studio model class (via a user override) or (b) load multiple model instances. Both stay in scope per the LM-Studio-only product boundary.
interpretation.dual_load_note: After 2026-05-24, this hardware also runs qwen3.6-35b alongside a second model for other workloads. Stress retries observed httpx.ReadTimeout against the lm-chat to LM Studio path because the two models compete for the single LM Studio inference queue. Baseline numbers above are from the single-model configuration (2026-05-23); they remain the cert reference. Re-running stress with qwen3.6 also loaded reproduces the timeout pattern; that is environmental, not a product regression.
